g.text: Regional progress and individual country gains are different summaries
A: hollow = 2015, filled = 2020; labels give median shift. B: dots = countries; circle/line = median/interquartile range of gains; black tick = median shift.
Fixed 175-country panel. Density shown for n >= 10 only; each row normalized separately. Intervals show spread, not confidence.
